音频素材只能放到音轨: Audio media can only be added to audio tracks
删除“{v0}”及其合成输出？不会删除源视频。: Delete “{v0}” and its rendered outputs? Source videos will be kept.
请从工作台进入项目后查看成片: Open a project in the studio to view edits
一次识别整条时间线中的视频原声和独立语音；背景音乐不会参与识别。: Transcribe video audio and speech across the timeline. Background music is excluded.
点击“智能字幕”自动识别全片: Click Auto captions to transcribe the entire timeline
添加后可在监看画面中直接拖动位置，并在右侧修改内容、时间、字号和颜色。: Drag text in the monitor to position it. Edit content, timing, font size and color on the right.
黑场插入播放头位置；淡入淡出应用到当前片段；常规转场连接当前片段和下一片段。: Insert black at the playhead. Fades apply to the selected clip; transitions connect it to the next clip.
播放时间，输入秒或分:秒后回车跳转: Playhead time. Enter seconds or minutes:seconds, then press Enter.
选中时间线片段后切换为片段属性: Select a timeline clip to view its properties
项目成片管理、时间线剪辑、自动字幕与 FFmpeg 合成。: Project edits, timeline editing, automatic captions, and FFmpeg rendering.
不传film_id创建；传film_id时部分更新方案，省略字段保留原值，显式传: Omit film_id to create; supply it for a partial update. Omitted fields remain unchanged; empty arrays or null clear them. clips is the sequential main track (kind=blank creates a black clip). overlay_clips and audio_clips use absolute start times. Select videos first, or use film.add-clip to add and select them automatically.
将视频加入指定成片: Add a video to an edit
导入本地素材到成片素材区: Import local media into the editor
仅删除当前项目中由成片插件导入、且没有被任何成片方案引用的素材。: Only deletes media imported by this plugin into the current project and not referenced by any edit.
使用系统安装的 FFmpeg 异步合成，返回成片详情；用 film.get 查询: Render asynchronously using the system FFmpeg installation. Returns edit details; use film.get to query render.status and progress. The composition stage is system-managed.
在预览或正式导出前只读检查素材文件、裁剪范围、音视频轨、字幕和输出参数，不创建渲: Check media, trim ranges, tracks, captions, and output settings without creating a render job. If valid=false, resolve the reported issues and validate again.
删除成片及合成输出: Delete an edit and its outputs
用系统安装的 FFmpeg 以低画质快速合成预览，用于剪辑确认；结果在 prev: Render a quick low-quality preview using system FFmpeg. The result is in preview.url and does not affect the final render. Use film.get to query preview.status and progress.
取消当前成片的正式合成或预览任务；不会删除已完成的历史版本。: Cancel the current render or preview without deleting completed versions.
识别全时间线生成字幕: Generate captions for the full timeline
提取并混合时间线上所有启用的主轨视频原声与独立语音素材，排除背景音乐后使用 Co: Mix enabled main-track video audio and independent speech sources, excluding background music, then transcribe the complete timeline using ComfyUI-Whisper.
为视频生成缩略图条与波形、为音频生成波形，返回图片地址与素材时长；同一素材重复调: Generate thumbnail strips and waveforms for video, and waveforms for audio. Returns image URLs and media duration; repeated calls reuse the cache.
